name: Shitao
bio: Shitao or Shi Tao, otherwise known as Yuan Ji, born into the Ming dynasty imperial clan as Zhu Ruoji (朱若極), was a Chinese Buddhist monk, calligrapher, and landscape painter during the early Qing dynasty.
